hero.title: Read and understand research papers
hero.subtitle: A smart PDF reader that lets you read your papers and ask questions about anything you don't understand. Get instant answers with precise citations.

features.title: Everything you need to understand research

items.title: Read Your PDFs
items.description: A clean, distraction-free PDF reader built for research. Read your papers comfortably with full navigation.

items.title: Ask Questions
items.description: Stuck on a concept? Just ask. Get clear explanations for anything you don't understand in the paper.

items.title: Precise Citations
items.description: Every answer comes with exact page references so you can jump right to the source and verify.

items.title: Create Collections
items.description: Organize your research into custom collections. Group papers by topic, project, or however you work best.

items.title: Access Anywhere
items.description: Your papers are securely stored in the cloud. Read and chat with your library from any device, anywhere.

items.title: AI-Powered Insights
items.description: Powered by advanced AI to understand complex academic language and break down difficult concepts for you.

items.title: Save for Later
items.description: Build your reading queue with papers you want to explore. Never lose track of important research again.

items.title: Dark Mode
items.description: Easy on the eyes during those late-night reading sessions. Full dark mode support throughout the app.

steps.title: Upload your PDF
steps.description: Drag and drop or browse to upload your research paper. We support files up to 5MB.

steps.title: Read your paper
steps.description: Open your PDF in our clean reader. Navigate pages, zoom, and read comfortably.

steps.title: Ask when stuck
steps.description: Don't understand something? Ask the AI and get clear explanations with page citations.

cta.title: Ready to read smarter?
cta.subtitle: Join researchers who understand papers faster with ThinkFolio. Free to get started.
